resources.string: You can import transactions from an XML backup file made with the SMS Backup & Restore app.

resources.string: This file is not an SMS Backup & Restore XML backup. Nothing was imported.
The backup file is damaged or incomplete, so the import stopped part way. Transactions imported before that point were kept. Importing again is safe and does not create duplicates.
The file could not be read. Any transactions imported before the problem were kept. Importing again is safe and does not create duplicates.
